hints.title: Alien Lexicographical Mapping
hints.text: Map each character in the alien alphabet string to its integer index for constant-time rank comparisons.

hints.title: Adjacent Word Verification
hints.text: The full array is sorted if and only if every pair of adjacent words words[i] and words[i + 1] is sorted lexicographically.

hints.title: Prefix and Character Comparison
hints.text: For adjacent words w1 and w2, compare characters up to the minimum length. If characters differ, w1 must have smaller rank than w2. If all matching characters are equal, w1 must not be longer than w2.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard sorting strings using ASCII order gives wrong answers because the alien alphabet has custom precedence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constructing the 26-element dictionary and scanning adjacent words runs in linear time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate must properly handle prefix conditions where one word is an exact prefix of another.
complexity.notes: If w1 starts with w2 and len(w1) > len(w2), e.g. "apple" vs "app", it is invalid.
